segments.sn36.19:1.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yenāyasmā udāyī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:1.2: “kati nu kho, bhante udāyi, vedanā vuttā bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn36.19:1.4: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā – imā kho, thapati, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:1.6: Evaṃ vutte, pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:1.7: “na kho, bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.sn36.19:1.8: Dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.19:1.10: Yāyaṃ, bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:2.1: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:2.2: “na kho, thapati, dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.sn36.19:2.4: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā – imā tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:2.6: Dutiyampi kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:2.7: “na kho, bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.sn36.19:2.8: Dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.19:2.10: Yāyaṃ, bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:3.1: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:3.2: “na kho, thapati, dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.sn36.19:3.4: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā – imā tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:3.6: Tatiyampi kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.19:3.7: “na kho, bhante udāyi, tisso vedanā vuttā bhagavatā.
segments.sn36.19:3.8: Dve vedanā vuttā bhagavatā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.19:3.10: Yāyaṃ, bhante, adukkhamasukhā vedanā, santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn36.19:3.11: Neva sakkhi āyasmā udāyī pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ saññāpetuṃ, na panāsakkhi pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ saññāpetuṃ.
segments.sn36.19:3.12: Assosi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato udāyissa pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
segments.sn36.19:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn36.19:4.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako āyasmato udāyissa pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
segments.sn36.19:5.1: “Santameva, ānanda, pariyāyaṃ pañcakaṅgo thapati udāyissa bhikkhuno nābbhanumodi;
segments.sn36.19:5.2: santañca panānanda, pariyāyaṃ udāyī bhikkhu pañcakaṅgassa thapatino nābbhanumodi.
segments.sn36.19:5.3: Dvepi mayā, ānanda, vedanā vuttā pariyāyena.
segments.sn36.19:5.10: Evaṃ pariyāyadesito kho, ānanda, mayā dhammo.
segments.sn36.19:5.11: Evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ, na samanumaññissanti, na samanujānissanti, na samanumodissanti, tesaṃ etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissantīti [viharissanti (sī. pī. ka.)].
segments.sn36.19:5.12: Evaṃ pariyāyadesito kho, ānanda, mayā dhammo.
segments.sn36.19:5.13: Evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumaññissanti samanujānissanti samanumodissanti, tesaṃ etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ – samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissantī”ti.
segments.sn36.19:6.3: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā … pe … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn36.19:6.6: Yaṃ kho, ānanda, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ – idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ.
segments.sn36.19:6.9: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:6.12: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:7.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:7.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:7.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:7.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:7.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:8.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:8.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:8.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:8.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:8.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:9.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:9.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti – ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:9.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:9.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:9.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:10.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:10.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:10.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:10.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:10.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:11.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:11.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā, paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā, nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā,‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:11.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:11.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:11.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:12.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:12.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma,‘anantaṃ viññāṇan’ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:12.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:12.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:12.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:13.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:13.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma,‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:13.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:13.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:13.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:14.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:14.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:14.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:14.5: ‘etaṃparamaṃ santaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī’ti – idaṃ nesāhaṃ nānujānāmi.
segments.sn36.19:14.8: Atthānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:15.1: “Katamañcānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca?
segments.sn36.19:15.2: Idhānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn36.19:15.3: Idaṃ kho, ānanda, etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
segments.sn36.19:16.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, ānanda, vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ –
segments.sn36.19:16.2: ‘saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samaṇo gotamo āha, tañca sukhasmiṃ paññapeti.
segments.sn36.19:16.4: Evaṃvādino, ānanda, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā –
segments.sn36.19:16.5: ‘na kho, āvuso, bhagavā sukhaññeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmiṃ paññapeti.
segments.sn36.19:16.6: Yattha yattha, āvuso, sukhaṃ upalabbhati, yahiṃ yahiṃ [yaṃ hiyaṃ hi sukhaṃ (sī. pī.), yahiṃ yahiṃ sukhaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.) ma. ni.2.91], taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmiṃ paññapetī’”ti.

lines: 267-268. Navame pañcakaṅgo thapatīti pañcakaṅgoti tassa nāmaṃ, vāsipharasunikhādanadaṇḍamuggarakāḷasuttanāḷisaṅkhātehi vā pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgatattā so pañcakaṅgoti paññāto.

Ettha ca kāyikacetasikavasena dve veditabbā, sukhādivasena tissopi, indriyavasena sukhindriyādikā pañca, dvāravasena cakkhusamphassajādikā cha, upavicāravasena “cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicaratī”tiādikā aṭṭhārasa, cha gehasitāni somanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni, cha gehasitāni domanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni, cha gehasitā upekkhā, cha nekkhammasitāti evaṃ chattiṃsa.
Tā atīte chattiṃsa, anāgate chattiṃsa, paccuppanne chattiṃsāti evaṃ aṭṭhasataṃ vedanā veditabbā.
Na kevalañhi dve ādiṃ katvā vedanā bhagavatā paññattā, pariyāyena ekāpi vedanā kathitā, taṃ dassento pañcakaṅgassa thapatino vādaṃ upatthambhetuṃ imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Ettha ca catutthajjhānato paṭṭhāya adukkhamasukhā vedanā, sāpi santaṭṭhena paṇītaṭṭhena ca sukhanti vuttā.
Pañcakāmaguṇavasena hi aṭṭhasamāpattivasena ca uppannaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ nāma, nirodho avedayitasukhaṃ nāma.
Iti vedayitasukhaṃ vā hotu avedayitasukhaṃ vā, niddukkhabhāvasaṅkhātena sukhaṭṭhena ekantasukhameva jātaṃ.
Sukhaṃ upalabbhatīti vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā avedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā upalabbhati.

Taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmiṃ paññapeti, taṃ sabbaṃ tathāgato niddukkhabhāvaṃ sukhasmiṃyeva paññapetīti idha bhagavā nirodhasamāpattiṃ sīsaṃ katvā neyyapuggalassa vasena arahattanikūṭeneva desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.
Pāṭiyekko anusandhīti pucchānusandhiādīhi visuṃ tehi asammisso eko anusandhi.
Ekāpi vedanā kathitā “tatra, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako”ti āharitvā “phassapaccayā vedanā”ti.
“atthānanda, etasmā sukhā aññaṃ sukhan”tiādiṃ vadanto thapatino vādaṃ upatthambheti nāma.
Tena hi upekkhāvedanā “sukhan” teva vuttā santasabhāvattā.
Sukhanti vuttā paṭipakkhassa suṭṭhu khādanena, sukaraṃ okāsadānamassāti vā.
